steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Planka at http://127.0.0.1:8104/ using email admin@example.com and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the signed-in app is open and report the page reached.
02-report: On the board Bench Board in project Bench Project, report the exact names of all cards whose names start with 'Seed:'; do not modify any cards.

03-create: On Bench Board in Bench Project, create a card named '{{runid}} Bench Card' in the 'In Progress' list. Set its description to a single paragraph containing the exact text '{{runid}}'. Save it, then verify the card is in In Progress, the description shows that paragraph exactly once, and report its card URL/ID.

04-create: On the card '{{runid}} Bench Card' on Bench Board, make its only label the existing exact label 'Hardware' (not Hardware Return or Hardware Spares; do not create a label). Verify the card shows Hardware as its only label.
05-verify: On the card '{{runid}} Bench Card' on Bench Board, make its only member the existing exact user 'Bench Tester' (not Bench Tester Lead). Verify the card shows only that member.
06-set: On the card '{{runid}} Bench Card' on Bench Board, set the due date to 2026-12-31 (any time of day is fine). Verify the saved due date shown on the card.
07-add: From the own view of card '{{runid}} Bench Card' on Bench Board, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}'. Submit it and verify the posted comment text on the card.
